summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 24.3 (true dual-tier Whisper: a second, optional quality-tier speech engine + one-shot re-transcription pipeline) is genuinely compiled into this rebuilt installer, with zero functional regression to every prior-phase Rust symbol.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 24.3's own commit) this rebuild was performed against. Phase 24.3 touches core/ai/src/speech_engine.rs and lib.rs, ai/speech/src/whisper.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/{config,state,lib,commands,persistence,events}.rs, database/{migrations/0019_transcript_corrections.sql,src/migrations.rs}, and the frontend (domain/ai.ts, lib/{commands,liveEvents}.ts, config/appConfig.ts, components/LiveChurchBrain.{tsx,css}, components/workspace/PilotDiagnosticsPanel.tsx, events/eventNames.{ts,test.ts}). This is the third consecutive rebuild this session (following Phase 24.1's gitCommit 472b91a and Phase 24.2's gitCommit b668be5) - all three closed real gaps identified by continuing directly from the operator's own follow-up direction.
buildLog: ran directly in this session (not committed - ephemeral build log)

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done.

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable. Every tripwire from Phase 24.2's own baseline (the most recent prior rebuild) was re-checked.
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresFromPriorPhasesDeviation: One, investigated and confirmed benign: retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context read 1 in Phase 24.2's own baseline, 2 here. Demangling both matches (via the same strings output) shows they are two genuinely distinct, pre-existing functions that happen to share a short name - `cip_desktop_lib::pipeline::retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context` (apps/desktop's own orchestration wrapper) and `cip_core_service::bible_intelligence::retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context` (the core crate's underlying implementation it calls into). Neither function's source changed this phase (pipeline.rs and core/service are both untouched in this phase's diff) - this is release-mode inlining variance shifting whether the linker's string-constant deduplication happened to merge the two symbols' backtrace-table strings into one entry or keep them as two, the same class of benign, already-documented variance as should_flush_early/classify_model_size_tier (Phase 21/22) reading 0 in some builds. All 27 other pre-existing tripwire symbols matched their Phase 24.2 baseline count exactly.

newTripwiresThisPhase.note: transcribe_once/take_last_final_window_audio (SpeechEngine trait methods, real overrides on WhisperSpeechEngine), spawn_quality_worker/install_whisper_quality_model (new commands.rs functions), and persist_transcript_correction (new persistence.rs function) are all confirmed present and compiled in. QualityTranscript (a plain data-only struct with no methods of its own) has no symbol table entry, matching the same benign class already documented for other data-only types in this project (e.g. DecodeOutcome was never tracked as a tripwire for the same reason) - its correctness is proven by the config.rs/persistence.rs unit tests and successful compilation/typechecking against its real field usage, not symbol presence.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe the same way Rust symbols are - the new quality-tier diagnostics section in PilotDiagnosticsPanel.tsx, the TRANSCRIPT_CORRECTED event handling in LiveChurchBrain.tsx, and the new commands.ts/liveEvents.ts wrappers were not independently string-searched, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness rests on npm run typecheck's success, the full 303/303 frontend test pass (unchanged count - only eventNames.test.ts's 'exactly N events' assertion was updated from 55 to 56), and npm run build's success - real-browser event-simulation verification (as Phase 24.2 performed for its own frontend change) was not performed this phase; see docs/phase-24-3-audit.md's own 'Real-browser verification' section for why it was judged not applicable to this phase's actual risk surface (two Whisper model instances and a second thread, not frontend rendering logic).
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero changes to any existing Tauri command's signature or behavior, zero changes to any existing event's payload shape, zero changes to any existing migration.

Two new Tauri commands (install_whisper_quality_model, cfg-gated identically to install_whisper_model), one new event (TRANSCRIPT_CORRECTED), one new migration (0019_transcript_corrections, purely additive - a new table, no existing table altered).

The quality tier is entirely opt-in and gated on state.speech_quality_ready at every entry point (channel/worker spawn in start_listening, diagnostics section visibility) - an operator who never installs a second model file gets zero new threads, zero new channel overhead, and zero behavior change to the fast tier's own live pipeline.

transcribe_once/take_last_final_window_audio never touch WhisperSpeechEngine's own self.buffer/self.elapsed_ms/self.sequence/self.window_id - confirmed by direct code review and preserved by construction (take_last_final_window_audio only ever takes an already-separately-stored Option<Vec<i16>>, transcribe_once takes &self, not &mut self) - so a second engine instance's transcribe_once call can never disturb the first engine's own live window.

Every prior-phase command and symbol remains present and unregressed - 27 of 28 pre-existing tripwires matched exactly, the 28th (retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context) investigated and confirmed a benign linker-level artifact of two genuinely distinct, unchanged functions, not a regression.
environmentCStatus: Not yet performed. This phase's entire real risk surface - two concurrently loaded Whisper models, a second worker thread, real audio hand-off between them, real decode timing/resource cost - has never run against real microphone audio with two real model files installed on real hardware. See docs/phase-24-3-audit.md's Known Limitations for the full, honest accounting of what remains unconfirmed.
